title: Meta Reports $825B in Future Lease Obligations for AI

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Off-balance-sheet agreements totaling $355.7 billion through 2036 are a prominent feature of the tech company's latest financial disclosures. Meta's total obligations for leases and contracts reached approximately $825 billion, an increase from the nearly $700 billion reported in July, and a large share of these commitments focuses on computing power and AI infrastructure.

The escalation in spending reflects the capital requirements for scaling generative AI capabilities. These multi-year contracts secure the hardware and data center facilities necessary for training and deploying large-scale models across Meta's platforms.
